The full test suite passes (BUILD SUCCESS). The change is complete.

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`generateCustomerCode`** now takes the city as well as the last name. It builds:
  - `CITY3` — upper-cased first three letters of the city
  - `LAST3` — upper-cased first three letters of the last name
  - `NNNN` — a **per-city** 4-digit zero-padded sequence, computed as one more than the number of existing owners already in that city (previously it was a global count of all owners).
- Updated the call site in `addOwner` to pass `owner.getCity()`.

Everything derived from `customerCode` rebuilds automatically: the `membershipNumber` in `OwnerMapper` is defined as `owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M" + <year>`, so it now carries the new city-prefixed code with no change needed there.

The acceptance test (which asserts `customerCode` matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`) and the full suite pass with **BUILD SUCCESS**.
